description: Orchestrator for agent-flow. Runs one GitHub (or local) issue through Implementer → Reviewer → QA → PR as separate processes with artifact-only handoff, mechanical risk classification, a hard review-round cap, and escalation to Needs Me. Use when the user runs /implement <issue> or asks to push an issue through the pipeline.
